ResNet-20-GN with the 19 Gaussian insertion sites. Above: one residual block, conv $\to$ $G_\sigma$ $\to$ GN $\to$ $\rho$ $\to$ conv $\to$ $G_\sigma$ $\to$ GN $\to$ $+$ $\to$ $\rho$; the forward hook rewrites each convolution's output, before GroupNorm and before the ReLU, and the shortcut carries no convolution so it is never hooked. Below: the network, stacked from those blocks --- a stem (site $0$) and nine blocks (two sites each), 16 / 32 / 64 channels at stages 1 / 2 / 3 on maps of $32{\times}32$ / $16{\times}16$ / $8{\times}8$. The filter is separable, depthwise and reflection-padded, with one fixed $9{\times}9$ support (radius $4$) for every $\sigma$; that support spans 28\% / 56\% / 112\% of the map width at stages 1 / 2 / 3. Insertion mask \texttt{all19} filters every site; \texttt{early7} filters only sites $0$--$6$, leaving the 12 deeper sites unfiltered.
